subject: Insurance
title: The Pill Mill Epidemic
description: One-minute skill: The Pill Mill Epidemic.

hook.text: In the 2000s, Florida's 'pill mills' prescribed opioids to anyone willing to pay cash. Insurance covered refills.

buildup.text: Doctors wrote thousands of prescriptions per month. Patients drove hundreds of miles to stock up.

discovery.text: Insurance companies paid billions in fraudulent prescriptions.

twist.text: Prescription drug monitoring programs eventually flagged the pattern. Florida shut down hundreds of clinics.

climax.text: Pill mills showed how insurance fraud can become a public health crisis.

punchline.text: Insurance paid for the pills. Pill mill fraud helped fuel the opioid epidemic.

quiz.question: How did pill mills connect to insurance fraud?
options: Insurance covered fraudulent opioid prescriptions at massive scale
